_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Osova ukuata Klondike Solitaire. Ondaka yawe ni kuendesa kadi zote ku mukulu wa kipungu.

Mukanda wa Mpira:
- Mukulu wa kipungu (F1-F4): Kuzenga kadi ku mpangula ku kipungu
- Mukulu wa kubaka (T1-T7): Kuzenga kadi ku mpangula ku ngola zinene (ngola nyama ku ngola ndombe, ngola ndombe ku ngola nyama)
- Kikwama: Kuinza kadi ku mukulu wa kubula
- Mukulu wa kubula (W): Kadi ya juu inafaa kubakwa

Makandida:
- 'draw' - Kuinza kadi ku kikwama ku mukulu wa kubula
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Kuhamisha kadi kati ya mukulu
  Mifano: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count inaweza kuwa 'all', ambayo itajaribu kuhamisha kadi zote zinazoweza kuonekana.
- 'forfeit' - Kuisha mpira mara moja na kufunga alama yawe
- Majina ya mukulu: W (kubula), F1-F4 (kipungu), T1-T7 (kubaka)

Unaweza kutekeleza matendo mengi katika zamu moja kwa kuyatenganisha na vigawanyiko:
  Mfano: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Kadi za Kifalme pekee zinaweza kuwekwa kwenye mukulu wa kubaka tupu.
Matendo yanatekelezwa kwa mpangula - ikiwa moja inashindwa, matendo yaliyosalia yanapuuzwa.
Tumia 'forfeit' ikiwa unafikiri mpira hauwezekani kushinda.
